fieldData.full-article-text:
For the Olympia mainnet, validator nodes will be entitled to receive a portion of the 300m XRD network emission that is generated by the protocol on an annual basis to secure the network. 

Additionally, a further 600m XRD is held in reserve by the Radix Foundation and can be used to subsidise node runners, at its discretion, if needed.

For more information please review the Radix Economics Whitepaper. We will be releasing more specific information about emissions and subsidy mechanisms closer to mainnet release.
